name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 15 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 1.78 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
